findings.title: Missing React key on GrafanaRuleListItem in the filtered rule list
findings.body: The old `<GrafanaRuleLoader key={key} .../>` became `<GrafanaRuleListItem .../>` with no `key`. It is returned from `rules.map(...)`, so the Grafana branch now has no stable key, unlike the datasource and unknown branches. React will warn and fall back to index-based reconciliation. As rules stream in or filters change, per-item state (delete modal, silence drawer, menu state) can attach to the wrong rule. Add `key={key}`.

findings.title: Silence menu item does nothing in the list view because the drawer requires a ruler rule
findings.body: In the list view `RuleActionsButtons` is now called with only `promRule`, so `rule` is undefined. `AlertRuleMenu` shows 'Silence notifications' based on the prom-rule ability, and the click calls `setShowSilenceDrawer(true)`. The drawer only renders when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) && showSilenceDrawer`, which is false without a ruler rule. The user clicks Silence and nothing happens. The drawer needs to work from the prom rule, or the item should be hidden.

findings.title: Delete and Pause actions are unreachable in the list view (permission computed from promRule, rendering needs rulerRule)
findings.body: The new code computes `canDelete` and `canPause` from `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities`. Rendering still requires a ruler rule: `canDelete && rulerRule` and `canPause && rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)`. In the list view `rulerRule` is undefined, so Delete and Pause never appear for Grafana rules, even for users with permission. This silently removes functionality, and the added tests only assert 4 items (no delete or pause) so they do not catch it. Either the handlers must work from the prom rule and identifier, or the abilities should not claim support.

findings.title: Federated rule group check dropped for legacy CombinedRule abilities
findings.body: `useAllAlertRuleAbilities(rule: CombinedRule)` previously used `isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` to mark federated groups as immutable. It now delegates to `useAllRulerRuleAbilities`, which hard-codes `isFederated = false` with a TODO. The legacy list (`RulesTable`) therefore treats federated data-source rule groups as editable and deletable, a behavior regression. The group is still available via `rule.group`, so the check can be preserved for the legacy path.

findings.title: View link no longer includes returnTo
findings.body: The removed `GrafanaRuleListItem` built the href with `createRelativeUrl(..., { returnTo: createReturnTo() })`. The new one links to `/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view` with no `returnTo`, so the 'back' navigation from the rule view to the list/filter state is lost. This is unmentioned in the PR and looks accidental.

findings.title: Stale comment/variable names reference ruler preload that was removed
findings.body: The ruler prefetch was removed, but the comment ('This is not mandatory to preload ruler rules...') and the variable `cacheAndRulerPreload` still describe ruler preloading. This is misleading and should be updated.

findings.title: Tests for creating/deleting operation states were removed without replacement
findings.body: The 'creating' (ruler-only) and 'deleting' (prom-only) list item tests and the `matchRules` tests were deleted. The new tests cover only the happy path and permissions. `GrafanaRuleListItem` still accepts an `operation` prop that nothing passes now. No test covers the recording-rule or unknown-rule branches of the new item, or the Delete and Pause menu behavior.
